question: How much rock was actually collected from the Kola borehole?
answer: Kola brought up 3,700.1 m of rock cores, dozens of times more than the few tens of meters oil wells usually core. Studying all of that rock was one of the reasons the project lasted 25 years.
move: Kola's treasure was not only depth: 3,700.1 m of rock cores.

web.label: One core tray drawn big, seen from above: five rows of rock core a metre long, 5 m a tray. The reader drags a zoom slider and the view pulls back over the trays, counting them, past the six that hold an oil well's few tens of metres, to all of Kola: 740 trays and 10 cm more, 3,700.1 m. Asks how much rock was actually collected from the Kola borehole.

source: Geopop, “Il buco più profondo della Terra, il racconto scientifico del pozzo Kola in Russia con animazioni 3D” (YouTube, 2023)
